chunks: Baziʿ al-Muʾadhdhin asked him and said to him:
I intend to undergo a procedure on my eye. He said to me: "Do it."
I said: They claim that he will be laid on his back for so-and-so many days and will not perform salat (prayer) sitting. He said: "Do it."

key_terms.أَقْدَحَ: to perform a medical procedure, here on the eye
key_terms.الْمُؤَذِّنُ: the muʾadhdhin, the one who gives the call to prayer
key_terms.بَزِيعٌ: Baziʿ, the narrator mentioned in the report

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to undergo eye treatment if it affects how one performs salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates the permissibility of undergoing treatment for the eye even if it temporarily affects one's normal performance of salat (prayer). It reflects a juristic concern for medical necessity and worship under constrained circumstances.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1036 - Bazi' the Muezzin asked Imam (as):

"I intend to undergo a procedure on my eye."
Imam (as) replied: "Do it."

Bazi' then said: "But they claim that I will be made to lie on my back for several days and will not be able to perform prayer while sitting."
Imam (as) replied: "Do it."
